# Kwai (3 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `handle` / `url` | 1 | Get a Kwai user profile |
| /user/posts | `handle` / `url` | 1 | List a Kwai user's posts |
| /post | *(none)* | 1 | Get a Kwai post |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `handle` *(optional, string)*: Kwai profile handle (without the @)
- `url` *(optional, string)*: Kwai profile URL
- `cursor` *(optional, string)*: Cursor from the previous response for the next page
- `count` *(optional, integer)*: Number of posts to return (max 50)
- `url (/post)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the Kwai post

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/kwai/profile?" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
